# Kyoto Family Trip Plan: 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-14

A 5-day Kyoto plan for **2 adults + 1 child (age 8)**, built around a **JPY 180,000 total budget** excluding international flights. I’m assuming a **moderate pace**, **shellfish-free meals**, and a mix of **sightseeing, easy walking, and family-friendly transit**.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary

### Day 1: Arrival, Central Kyoto, and Easy Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Kyoto, check in, and keep the first half-day light.
- Afternoon: Explore **Kyoto Station area** and **Kyoto Tower**; good for an easy first outing and indoor backup if weather changes.
- Evening: Walk around **Kawaramachi / Shijo** for dinner and a low-effort riverfront stroll.
- Local transport: **JPY 1,500–2,500** total
- Meal 1: **Udon set** with rice ball or tempura-free side, **JPY 1,200–1,800 per adult**
- Meal 2: **Family restaurant dinner** with curry, grilled chicken, or hamburger steak, **JPY 3,500–5,500 for the family**

### Day 2: Arashiyama and Monkey Park
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Visit **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** early, then **Tenryu-ji garden** if the child is still energetic.
- Afternoon: Cross **Togetsukyo Bridge** and consider **Iwatayama Monkey Park** if your family is comfortable with a hill climb.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for a relaxed dinner near your hotel.
- Local transport: **JPY 2,000–3,500** total
- Meal 1: **Soba or udon lunch** with chicken or vegetable toppings, **JPY 1,200–1,700 per adult**
- Meal 2: **Teishoku dinner** with grilled fish/chicken or pork cutlet, confirm no shellfish broth, **JPY 4,000–6,500 for the family**

### Day 3: Fushimi Inari and Southern Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Fushimi Inari Taisha** for a shorter, kid-friendly climb to the first scenic checkpoints.
- Afternoon: Visit **Tofuku-ji** area or return to the city for **Nishiki Market** browsing and snack shopping.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Visit **Tofuku-ji** area or return to the city for **Nishiki Market** browsing and snack shopping, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Choose a calm dinner near Kyoto Station or Shijo.
- Local transport: **JPY 1,500–2,500** total
- Meal 1: **Katsu curry** or chicken curry lunch, **JPY 1,000–1,600 per adult**
- Meal 2: **Yakiniku or grilled chicken set** with rice and soup, ask for non-seafood soup base, **JPY 4,500–7,000 for the family**

### Day 4: Higashiyama, Gion, and Classic Kyoto Streets
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Start at **Kiyomizu-dera** and walk downhill through preserved lanes like **Sannenzaka** and **Ninenzaka**.
- Afternoon: Continue to **Yasaka Shrine** and **Maruyama Park**; this is a good slower-paced day with lots of rest stops.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Continue to **Yasaka Shrine** and **Maruyama Park**; this is a good slower-paced day with lots of rest stops, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Stroll **Gion** and have an early dinner.
- Local transport: **JPY 1,500–2,500** total
- Meal 1: **Japanese set lunch** with chicken, tofu, or pork, **JPY 1,200–1,900 per adult**
- Meal 2: **Sushi-free izakaya-style meal** with grilled items, omelet, fried chicken, and rice, **JPY 4,500–7,500 for the family**

### Day 5: Nijo Castle, Kyoto Imperial area, and Departure Buffer
- Morning: Visit **Nijo Castle** for an easy final sightseeing stop with manageable walking.
- Afternoon: If time allows, add **Kyoto Imperial Palace Park** or souvenir shopping near Kyoto Station.
Media: Alt=Afternoon: If time allows, add **Kyoto Imperial Palace Park** or souvenir shopping near Kyoto Station, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Depart or enjoy a final dinner before leaving.
- Local transport: **JPY 1,500–2,500** total
- Meal 1: **Café lunch / curry rice / omurice**, **JPY 1,000–1,700 per adult**
- Meal 2: **Hotel or station-area dinner** with grilled meat or pasta, confirm no shellfish stock, **JPY 4,000–6,500 for the family**

## Hotel Areas Ranked for Convenience and Family Comfort

### 1) Kyoto Station Area
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Best for: **Easy arrivals, train access, luggage handling**
- Why it works: Fast transfers to Arashiyama, Fushimi Inari, and day trips; many hotels have family rooms.
- Trade-off: Less atmospheric than Gion/Higashiyama.
- Good for your budget: Often the best balance of price and convenience.

### 2) Kawaramachi / Shijo
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Best for: **Dining, shopping, central city access**
- Why it works: Easy evening walks, many restaurants, good bus/rail links, lively but still practical.
- Trade-off: Can be busier and noisier at night.
- Good for your budget: Strong if you want food variety and a central base.

### 3) Gion / Higashiyama Edge
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Best for: **Atmosphere, sightseeing on foot**
- Why it works: Close to Kiyomizu-dera, Yasaka Shrine, and classic Kyoto streets.
- Trade-off: Hotels can be pricier and rooms may be smaller.
- Good for your budget: Best if you prioritize location over room size.

## Budget Plan for 5 Days in Kyoto

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel | JPY 75,000–105,000 | Family room or 2 rooms in mid-range areas |
| Local transport | JPY 8,000–13,000 | Trains, buses, occasional taxi |
| Meals | JPY 45,000–60,000 | Moderate budget, shellfish-free choices |
| Sightseeing entry | JPY 12,000–20,000 | Mix of paid temples, castle, monkey park |
| Snacks / extras | JPY 8,000–15,000 | Drinks, desserts, souvenirs |
| Buffer | JPY 10,000–15,000 | Weather, taxi, small overages |

Estimated trip total: **JPY 158,000–228,000**
- To stay near **JPY 180,000**, aim for:
  - Hotel: **JPY 80,000–90,000**
  - Meals: **JPY 45,000–50,000**
  - Transport + entry + extras: **JPY 45,000–55,000**

## Practical Family Notes

- Kyoto buses can get crowded; for a family, **trains + occasional taxi** are often easier.
- For shellfish avoidance, ask for:
  - **“No seafood / no shellfish”**
  - **“No dashi from bonito or seafood if possible”**
- Best kid-friendly pacing:
  - Keep one major temple/shrine in the morning
  - Add one easy afternoon stop
  - Leave evenings flexible
